content:
I finally started to try AI tools. I have a $20/month Claude plan and am using the Claude Code extension of VScode. Are there any tutorials or cheatsheets for using AI tools with Lean that I can read? I am also interested in trying out different AI tools, so I would appreciate comparisons of tools as well.

Right now I still write all my definitions and theorem statements and just ask Claude to replace sorrys with proofs. I'm not very interested in auto-formalization, as understanding the math is my main motivation. But I do want to use AI to dispatch tedious proofs.

One thing you should probably do is to install a lean4-skill:

https://github.com/cameronfreer/lean4-skills

..and maybe sign up for

https://aristotle.harmonic.fun/
